title: Orientation
description: auto follows the source's shape: one line in a flat box, a title line over a stars/mods/mapper line once the box is about 66 px tall or more, a column in an upright box. horizontal never uses the column; vertical always does.

title: Alignment
description: Which edge the line hugs inside the source; mirrors the column and its progress rule. auto centres it in the top slot (osu!, taiko, catch) and right-aligns it against the stage in mania, matching the suggested placements.

title: Motion
description: full = the strip settles in and out with play, a line too long for the box scrolls through once when a new map starts, kiai sections lift the progress rule. reduced = the strip still eases in and out; long lines never scroll and kiai changes nothing. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.

title: Map colour
description: Colour the map's identity (the progress rule and the star) from the map's background. Off = neutral. Your own highlights stay 18-LAB amber either way.

title: Original-language metadata
description: Show artist and title in their original script when the map provides it; otherwise the romanised fields are used.

title: Star rating
description: The map's star rating with the active mods applied (the same number as now-playing). Hidden while the map has no rating.

title: Progress and time
description: A hairline under the line that fills as the map plays (the same progress as strain-graph and now-playing).

title: Mods
description: Mods of the current play, with a custom rate. Hidden when no mods are active.

title: Mapper
description: The mapper after the stars and mods. Left out on its own whenever the map line would otherwise be cut.

title: Long lines
description: A line too long for the box rests with an ellipsis; the title's bracketed suffix and the difficulty give way before the title. once = the first time a map is played it scrolls through once, then rests (motion full only; retries do not scroll). truncate = it never moves. The column wraps instead.
